one_line: An expert announces her own book and shows the back cover with the child's photo and name by 0:04.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman sits cross-legged on a rug and holds a colourful cover toward the lens. Said to the lens (transcript): "אני עדיין לא מאמינה שאני אומרת את זה, אבל כתבתי ספר". Subtitles from 0:01, "ספר" large at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: A face speaking to the lens with a bright cover in hand and a personal surprise, "but I wrote a book", gives a person, voice and product at once (H4, F6, H1). The news lands at 0:03 (H5), written from 0:01 (H6). What the book gives a child comes only at 0:09 to 0:16 (H2).

beats.what: She holds the colourful cover to the lens; "עדיין לא מאמינה שאני אומרת", then "ספר"
beats.why: A personal surprise with the product in hand

beats.what: The back cover: a child's round photo, the name, a logo; "אפילו מופיע על כל אחד מהעותקים"
A zoom-blur transition; a hand turns the letter page; a toddler looks at the open book
beats.why: A change of picture and a real reader

beats.what: She flips the open book near the lens; "רגע לפני השינה", "בכל עמוד תמצאו טיפים ממני"
beats.why: Says what the book does: bedtime messages and tips

beats.what: She flips on; "לא פחות חשוב", "אישי", "של הילד"; a page of story thumbnails at 0:30
beats.why: The personalising point, in her words

beats.what: She holds the cover again and points; "למסע ביער החלומות", "כל הפרטים בתיאור"
beats.why: Back to the opening frame with a pointer to the caption

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: comment "מסע" for a link by message, a bio link, a code, and a request to report back. The video itself asks nothing beyond "כל הפרטים בתיאור".
q2_flow.why: The announcement and the back-cover reveal give a clear opening (H5, K2). From 0:14 one low take of fast page flips carries an explanation the pages cannot show, since their text is unreadable (R3, F4). It loops to the cover at 0:34 (R4) and ends soon after the ask (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:35 to 0:37: "כל הפרטים בתיאור". Caption: "לינק לרכישה- בביו"; comment "מסע" to get a link by message; discount code "dyadana".
q3_cta.why: The video points to the caption, said and written after the book is shown (C6), and the caption has a comment word that delivers a link (C3, R6). But it offers three routes, bio link, comment word and a code (C1), and the video never names the word.

q4_shown.what: The cover held to the lens (0:00); the back cover with a child's round photo, the name and a logo (0:04 to 0:10); the parent-letter page and a toddler with the book (0:11); page flips; six story thumbnails (0:30). No price.
q4_shown.why: The back cover shows a real child's photo with the name for about 6 s, the personalising proof a buyer needs (S2, S8), though never beside the cartoon cover. Her sleep-consultant role is only in the caption (S6). Pages flip too fast to read (F4). A child's photo, name and a toddler's face show (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 5 shots in 37 s: a static low shot, a blur transition at 0:10, 2 s of toddler B-roll, a 20 s handheld flip-through, a final static cover. Subtitles change about every second; key single words are large.
q5_edit.why: Word-by-word subtitles with large single key words add a pulse to long takes (E4, T2). The flip-through's blur hides the pages, and a 20 s take is long for a spoken explanation (R1, E2). It ends on the cover and the ask with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A sleep consultant announces the bedtime book she wrote, personalised with the child's name and photos, with parent tips on each page. Serves parents who want a calm bedtime routine.
q6_topic.why: A bedtime routine is a real parent concern, from a professional with her own tips (K6, K4, S6). The claims are about connection and regulation, modest and unmeasured (K4). No emotional peak, apart from a short toddler shot (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone propped on the floor, low angle, a woman cross-legged on a rug before a white wall in soft indoor light; she holds covers to the lens, then flips the book close to it. A 2 s top-down hand shot and a toddler B-roll.
q7_filmed.why: A face to the lens at home gives a direct, personal feel (F6, H8, F7), and the covers fill the frame when held up (F4). The low angle shows her legs and the rug, the book hides her face at 0:07, and flipped pages move fast and blur (F7, F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles with a dark outline, two to three lines or single large words, centred at about 57 to 68% of the frame height, changing about every second: "עדיין לא מאמינה שאני אומרת את זה" (0:01), "ספר" (0:03, large), "וזה אפילו מופיע על כל אחד מהעותקים שלו" (0:06), "בכל עמוד תמצאו טיפים ממני" (0:20), "אישי" (0:26, large), "למסע" (0:34), "כל הפרטים בתיאור" (0:35). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "אחד משיתופי הפעולה המרגשים עבורי. הספר הראשון שלי!". About 205 words: the book's idea, her sleep-consultant role, the personalising, printing in Israel, a gift line, link in bio, comment "מסע", a code, 2 hashtags; "בשיתוף @mebook.ai" near the end.
q8_text.why: Outlined subtitles with large key words carry the message muted (T1, T2, T5), but the three-line cards cross her chest and the book at the edge of the bottom 35% (T4). The caption opens with the collaboration and the news, names the product and has 2 specific hashtags (T7, T8).

weak_points: Page flips blur and the tips text is unreadable; her expert role is only in the caption; three CTA routes and the comment word not in the video; her face hidden at 0:07; a child's photo with his name.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the book to a propped phone, show the back cover with a sample photo and name early, flip slowly, end on the cover and one CTA.
not_verified: Music (cannot hear); who the toddler is; the price; whether the back-cover photo is the child of the cover character (never shown side by side). Corrections to src/coded: there is a zoom-blur transition at 0:10, a top-down hand shot at 0:11 and a toddler shot at 0:12 to 0:14; she covers the lens with the back cover at 0:07; the expert role is only in the caption.
